name: London System — Classical Setup
description: The most popular d4 system at club level. White builds a solid pyramidal structure with d4-e3-c3 and develops the bishops actively before committing the center. After 8...b6, both sides have staked out their plans — White controls the center, Black seeks queenside counter-play.

lines.name: London System — Classical Setup
lines.description: White develops Bf4 before e3 — the defining move-order trick of the London. The d4-e3-c3 pawn pyramid is rock-solid. After Nd2, Ngf3, Bg3, and Bd3, White has a harmonious, low-theory setup that fights for long-term positional pressure. Black's ...Bd6-...b6 plan contests the light squares and prepares queenside play.
